# qrcode-generator 1.4.4

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/1.4.4

Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Archive SHA-1: `63f771224854759329a99048806a53ed278740e7`.

Vendored because the workspace-wide dependency resolver could not fetch unrelated registry metadata. Only the JavaScript generator, TypeScript declarations and upstream README are included. The UMD export and its declaration were adapted to an ES default export; the QR encoding implementation is unchanged. No remote QR generation service receives login contents.
